name: Raymarching with Depth Buffer Occlusion
aliases: Volumetric Ray Marching with Depth Buffer Occlusion
definition: A technique to allow raymarched distance field objects to occlude and be occluded by standard mesh-based objects by using the scene's depth buffer to limit the raymarch loop.
summary: Raymarching with Depth Buffer Occlusion allows SDF objects to correctly occlude and be occluded by standard mesh geometry by sampling the depth buffer to terminate raymarching early.
